description: Camera make and model, lens, date taken, exposure (ISO, shutter, aperture, focal length), orientation, image size, software, and GPS latitude, longitude and altitude with a map link, from the EXIF of a JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PNG image at a URL. Only the first 256 KB is read. A file that is not an image is 415; an image without EXIF is 200 with hasExif false. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
